contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ ANTONINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ LAETITIA PVBL

A very fine silver Roman denarius of Elagabulus (AD 218-22), dating to AD 219 (Reece Period 10), LAETITIA PVBL, Laetitia standing left holding wreath and rudder on globe. Mint of Rome. RIC IV, pt. 2, p. 35, no. 95. Obverse type.:Laureate, draped right. Obverse legend: ANTONINVS PIVS AVG. Reverse type.:Laetitia standing left, holding wreath and rudder on globe. Reverse legend: LAETITIA PVBL.…
